notes: Internal or layered mesh contains disconnected shells, but visually continuous and solid at table distance.

blind.description: A stylized rustic log bench consisting of a thick split-log seat with natural live edges and wood grain textures, resting on two horizontal cylindrical log segments as legs. The model has clean, solid, and continuous surfaces without broken meshes, holes, or floating elements. It sits directly on the ground via its two log supports without any artificial base slab.
blind.from_above: An elongated rectangular wooden plank with organic wavy live edges on the long sides, straight cut ends, and visible wood grain with a knot near the center-top.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.3 to 1.5 feet tall (roughly one-fourth the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure), and approximately 4.5 to 5 feet in length.
